name: Ahmad Iskandar
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally. After a decade in corporate HR, a chance encounter with a Boutsen VDS engineer at a local motorsports event ignited a passion for the sport. He saw an opportunity to apply his expertise in a dynamic and exciting environment. Since joining Boutsen VDS, Ahmad has focused on fostering a supportive and inclusive team culture, believing that happy employees are productive employees. He excels at bridging the gap between technical staff and management, ensuring everyone is aligned with the team's objectives.

Ahmad's approach to HR is deeply rooted in understanding the unique needs of a motorsport team. He champions employee development programs tailored to enhance technical skills and promotes open communication channels to address concerns promptly. His colleagues know him as a fair and approachable leader who consistently goes the extra mile to support his team. Ahmad is particularly proud of his work in attracting and retaining top talent to Boutsen VDS, contributing to the team's competitive edge on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a sturdy build and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down employee feedback.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Insists on having traditional Malaysian snacks at every meeting.
